segments.an5.179:1.1: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.an5.179:1.2: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an5.179:1.3: “yaṃ kañci [yaṃ kiñci (sī. pī.)], sāriputta, jāneyyātha gihiṃ odātavasanaṃ pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammantaṃ catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhiṃ akicchalābhiṃ akasiralābhiṃ, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya –
segments.an5.179:1.4: ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’”ti.
segments.an5.179:2.2: Idha, sāriputta, ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
segments.an5.179:3.1: “Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī?
segments.an5.179:3.2: Idha, sāriputta, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.an5.179:3.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an5.179:3.4: Ayamassa paṭhamo ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
segments.an5.179:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, ariyasāvako dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.an5.179:4.2: ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti.
segments.an5.179:4.3: Ayamassa dutiyo ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
segments.an5.179:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, ariyasāvako saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.an5.179:5.2: ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti.
segments.an5.179:5.3: Ayamassa tatiyo ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
segments.an5.179:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, ariyasāvako ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.an5.179:6.2: Ayamassa catuttho ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
segments.an5.179:6.3: Imesaṃ catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an5.179:7.1: “Yaṃ kañci, sāriputta, jāneyyātha gihiṃ odātavasanaṃ – imesu pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammantaṃ, imesañca catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhiṃ akicchalābhiṃ akasiralābhiṃ, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya –
segments.an5.179:7.2: ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’”ti.
segments.an5.179:9.3: Musā ca na bhaṇe jānaṃ, adinnaṃ na parāmase.
segments.an5.179:10.3: Merayaṃ vāruṇiṃ jantu, na pive cittamohaniṃ.
segments.an5.179:11.3: Abyāpajjaṃ [abyāpajjhaṃ (?) abyāpajjhaṃ (ka.)] hitaṃ cittaṃ, devalokāya bhāvaye.
segments.an5.179:12.1: “Upaṭṭhite deyyadhamme, puññatthassa jigīsato [jigiṃsato (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)];
segments.an5.179:12.3: Santesu paṭhamaṃ dinnā, vipulā hoti dakkhiṇā.
segments.an5.179:13.3: Iti kaṇhāsu setāsu, rohiṇīsu harīsu vā.
segments.an5.179:14.3: Yāsu kāsuci etāsu, danto jāyati puṅgavo.
segments.an5.179:15.3: Tameva bhāre yuñjanti, nāssa vaṇṇaṃ parikkhare.
segments.an5.179:19.3: Tasmiñca viraje khette, vipulā hoti dakkhiṇā.
segments.an5.179:20.3: Bahiddhā dadanti dānāni, na hi sante upāsare.
segments.an5.179:21.3: Saddhā ca nesaṃ sugate, mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā.
segments.an5.179:22.1: “Devalokañca te yanti, kule vā idha jāyare;

lines: Ariyadhammaṃ samādāyāti ettha ariyadhammoti pañca sīlāni kathitāni.
Vipulā hoti dakkhiṇāti evaṃ dinnadānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti.
Navame ābhicetasikānanti abhicetoti abhikkantaṃ visuddhacittaṃ vuccati adhicittaṃ vā, abhicetasi jātāni ābhicetasikāni, abhiceto sannissitānīti vā ābhicetasikāni.
Diṭṭhadhammoti paccakkho attabhāvo vuccati, tattha sukhavihārānanti attho.
Tāni hi appetvā nisinnā jhāyino imasmiṃyeva attabhāve asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ vindanti, tasmā “diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānī”ti vuccanti.
Catubbidhamerayanti pupphāsavo, phalāsavo, guḷāsavo, madhvāsavoti evaṃ catuppabhedaṃ merayaṃ.
Pañcavidhañca suranti pūvasurā, piṭṭhasurā, odanasurā, kiṇṇapakkhittā, sambhārasaṃyuttāti evaṃ pañcappabhedaṃ suraṃ.
Yasmā panesa puññena atthiko nāma hoti, tasmā vuttaṃ “puññena atthikassā”ti.
